admission_observation.self_reference_rule: The sealed receipt contains neither its own SHA256 nor command 7's result. Command 7 reads the receipt and custody observation without writing either and emits its deterministic observation to stdout.

candidate.input_hash_scope: Every source, test, policy, catalog, schema, and verifier file loaded from the candidate.

custody.independence: The custodian is independent of candidate authors and the evidence operator.

enforcement_scope.required_follow_up: A separately reviewed plan must identify and fail-close every authoritative phase-loop and standalone/manual closeout consumer on the same verification observation.

completed_transition_guard.manifest_write_precondition: Rerun the read-only current-acceptance verification against exact HEAD before appending.
metadata_binds: proven pre-write candidate commit and tree
completed_transition_guard.path_constraints: Receipt and custody paths are repository-relative regular non-symlinks below .phase-loop/evidence/RUNTIME/current/.

sequence: Retain committed through policy and mechanism preparation.
Append and land the legal committed-to-executing transition with actual run metadata.
Require a clean sealed candidate containing that executing event before producing evidence.
Bind receipt, custody, and read-only verification to that exact executing candidate.
Only after authoritative closeout enforcement exists may an executing-to-completed append bind the proven pre-write candidate.

ordering.step: Policy is approved on concrete reviewed bytes and the tests-first mechanism is separately reviewed and landed.
The manifest legally transitions committed to executing and that event is part of the clean candidate.

Commands 1-6 and 8-12, every explicitly specified catalog mutation case with its own restored-control run, current CI, and independent exact-candidate source approval produce immutable pre-admission evidence.
The recorder validates the complete pre-admission set and seals runtime_current_acceptance.v1 once.
An independent custodian archives successful and unsuccessful evidence, restores and verifies it, and emits runtime_current_acceptance_custody.v1.
Command 7 performs read-only verification and emits runtime_current_acceptance_verification.v1.
Only separately enforced authoritative closeout may consume the observation and request executing to completed.

required_sections.authority: EC-RUNTIME-6, exact executing manifest state and latest authority, exact policy review, final operator approval, and mechanism review.
required_sections.candidate: Exact clean repository commit/tree and complete candidate input-file hashes.
required_sections.custody_scope: Successful and unsuccessful evidence to archive plus required custodian independence.
required_sections.downstream: Explicit false values for every historical, interface, source-review, and downstream claim not independently established.
required_sections.falsifier_runs: Complete accounting for every explicit mutation_cases item in every catalog row, with an independent mutated arm and exact-candidate-restored control for each case. Row-level or grouped credit cannot replace a case result; the required case set is derived from the reviewed catalog rather than a fixed count.
required_sections.historical_disposition: EC-RUNTIME-0 unproven_evidence_loss, both missing roots, archived legacy failure, and the inventory digest with unknown-descendant limit.
required_sections.reviews: All required role identities and exact-candidate independence dispositions.
required_sections.validation_contract: Exact approved catalog and schema/verifier digests.
required_sections.verification: Immutable producer results for commands 1-6 and 8-12, current CI, and complete outcome accounting.

required_future_code.authoritative_closeout_consumers: A later separately scoped and reviewed plan; consumers are not implemented or authorized by this carrier.

review_constraints: The source approver is independent of candidate authors and approves the exact candidate.
The custodian is independent of candidate authors and the evidence operator.
The receipt records reviewer identities, vendors, author overlap, usable status, grounding, and exact-artifact binding.
Unavailable, errored, empty, capped, refused, timed-out, ungrounded, or unbound results do not count.

verification_accounting.required_outcome_rule: Zero unexplained failures, errors, skips, deselections, or omitted required suites.

execution_contract.loaded_source_evidence: Record __file__ and SHA256 for every candidate-owned production, test, and verifier module loaded by the case and prove each resolves inside the isolated exact-candidate checkout. Record the external interpreter and dependency identities separately; they cannot replace or shadow a candidate-owned module.
execution_contract.mutation_case_coverage: Each mutation_cases item is a separate case. Run and record its mutated arm and its own exact-candidate-restored arm even when several cases share a row or command. Parameterized cases require one independent arm for every member selected by the case definition. Derive coverage from the reviewed catalog; do not assume a fixed case count.
execution_contract.restore_evidence: For each explicit mutation case, record the restored production bytes and SHA256, then rerun the identical command to the stated positive control before crediting that case.
execution_contract.symbol_entry_evidence: Record entry of every named function or construction site before the intended observable is asserted.

rows.intended_observable: The existing short-write assertion fails after one partial os.write because the full record is not drained.
mutation_cases: Replace _write_fully's drain loop with one os.write call that returns short.
rows.restore_control: The same test passes and records _append and _write_fully entry after exact bytes are restored.

rows.intended_observable: The ordered-fd assertion fails because no regular-file fsync occurs after the write even though parent-directory fsync remains.
mutation_cases: Remove only the post-write os.fsync(fd) from _append while retaining os.fsync(parent_fd).
rows.restore_control: The same test observes write, regular-file fsync, then parent-directory fsync after restoration.

rows.intended_observable: A real registry divergence fails to clear carried verification and approval or fails to emit the frozen invalidation trigger.
mutation_cases: Suppress registry divergence in reconcile_train_state while still entering it.
Bypass invalidate_action_evidence in reconcile_before_action while still entering the full action-time chain.
rows.restore_control: The same test records all three entries and clears carried evidence for actual divergent registry state.

rows.intended_observable: The counted boundary assertion fails when any Git, GitHub, provider, or registry production reader is omitted or reused from cache.
mutation_cases: Bypass or reuse cached output from the Git production boundary reader while preserving fresh reads from the other three domains.
Bypass or reuse cached output from the GitHub production boundary reader while preserving fresh reads from the other three domains.
Bypass or reuse cached output from the provider production boundary reader while preserving fresh reads from the other three domains.
Bypass or reuse cached output from the registry production boundary reader while preserving fresh reads from the other three domains.
rows.restore_control: A matching four-domain run proves one fresh read per domain; a divergent-registry run proves the registry arm drives verdict and invalidation.

rows.intended_observable: The valid positive route fails if conformance, version/executable checks, run_bounded, frozen-envelope binding, or zero coordination calls are bypassed.
mutation_cases: Bypass valid conformance before the outside-agent route enters run_bounded.
Bypass expected-version validation while preserving import and route entry.
Bypass executable validation while preserving import and route entry.
Bypass run_bounded while allowing the route to return.
Corrupt the frozen result envelope's attempt or version binding after bounded execution.
Bypass the non-coordination guard and perform one coordination call.
rows.restore_control: A valid canonical submission enters conformance and run_bounded, preserves attempt/version binding, returns the frozen success envelope, and records zero coordination calls.

rows.intended_observable: Two fresh processes differ, consult poisoned transcript/cache state, or mutate the durable event log.
mutation_cases: Route train-status through transcript state in a fresh process.
Route train-status through poisoned cache state in a fresh process.
Bypass read_convergence_events while preserving command entry.
Bypass recover_train_state while preserving command entry.
rows.restore_control: Two fresh interpreter processes, with transcript absent and cache paths poisoned, emit identical JSON and human state and leave the log byte-identical.

rows.intended_observable: The current-authority assertion fails when latest authority is ignored while the first historical authority remains intact.
mutation_cases: Resolve current plan bytes from the first authority row instead of the latest row.
Resolve current roadmap bytes from the first authority row instead of the latest row.
rows.restore_control: The historical assertion uses the first authority and the current-byte assertion uses the latest authority.

rows.intended_observable: The unconditional export assertion fails while module import itself still succeeds.
mutation_cases: Rebind RUNTIME_CAPABILITY_VERSION away from 1 while preserving successful module import.
Remove only RUNTIME_CAPABILITY_VERSION membership from __all__ while preserving successful module import and the bound value.
rows.restore_control: The loaded source path/digest is recorded and the test unconditionally requires presence, value 1, and __all__ membership. INTEG consumption remains independently open.

rows.intended_observable: Verification fails closed on a missing, extra, stale, contradictory, or mismatched required field or reference.
mutation_cases: For every required receipt or custody schema field, remove that field in an independent arm.
At every closed receipt or custody schema object level, add an unknown field in an independent arm.
For every candidate, policy, catalog, schema, verifier, receipt, custody, or evidence identity/reference field, substitute a stale or mismatched value in an independent arm.
For every receipt or custody cross-field invariant, make the bound values contradictory in an independent arm.
rows.restore_control: The same test accepts only the closed schema and recomputed exact references after restoration.

rows.intended_observable: The v10-RUNTIME executing-to-completed manifest transition is rejected before write when receipt, custody, candidate, or verification binding is absent or mismatched.
mutation_cases: Allow completed when the required receipt is missing or mismatched.
Allow completed when the required custody observation is missing or mismatched.
Allow completed when the requested exact-HEAD candidate differs from the receipt candidate.
Allow completed without a successful immediate pre-write read-only verification observation.
rows.restore_control: A valid executing-to-completed request embeds the deterministic pre-write observation and input digests; broader closeout remains blocked until separately enforced.
